name: Startup School 2026
eligibility: Open to promising builders worldwide
description: Highly selective in-person event. YC hand-selects promising builders and flies them to SF for 2 days (July 25-26 2026). Strong signal for future YC applicants.
notes: Application asks about things built and coding agent sessions

name: The Eigenprize
eligibility: Anyone who builds discovers or does things. No age interest or location limits.
description: 10-minute application for up to $100k. No strings attached - no equity taken zero expectations. For builders scientists and operators.
notes: Very quick application process by design

name: Comma Zero 2.0
eligibility: College students recent grads (up to 1 year) HS students dropouts or non-college
description: First check program for young founders. Positions itself as founders first believer. Believes AI is the great equalizer for young founders.

name: AI4PH Internship Program
eligibility: Must have legal work authorization in Canada. International students with study permits allowing off-campus work eligible.
description: Part-time (10-15 hrs/week) internship applying AI/ML to public health challenges. Work with 12 host organizations across Canada. Some positions remote.

name: O'Shaughnessy Fellowship
eligibility: Adults worldwide. Seeks self-directed individuals with demonstrated initiative.
compensation_details: $100k fellowship (10 awards) or $10k+ grant (up to 20 awards)
description: One-year program for builders researchers and creatives. No equity taken. Access to network of founders investors mentors. Rolling review - most hear back within 30 days.

name: Founders Inc
eligibility: Builders in emerging tech (AR/VR hardware AI/ML Web3 dev tools consumer). Must show previous project success and traction.
description: Not a traditional accelerator - a long-term home to build. Includes desk space hardware lab gym office hours fundraising support. No decks or pitches - apply then build at lab for 1-2 weeks.

name: IAPS AI Policy Fellowship
organization: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy
eligibility: Applicants with policy and technical backgrounds at various seniority levels. Fellows range from mid-undergraduate to experienced professionals.
description: Fully-funded program for professionals from varied backgrounds seeking to strengthen practical policy skills for securing a positive future with powerful AI.

name: Critical University Impact Prize
eligibility: Student and recent alumni founders tackling major crises in climate healthcare and economic opportunity.
description: Inaugural pitch competition with $100K grand prize. Judges and mentors include partners at Khosla Ventures and General Catalyst. Part of Critical Venture Partners $5M fund for student founders.

name: KAUST VSRP Internship
organization: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
eligibility: 3rd and 4th-year bachelor's and master's students in STEM fields.
description: Visiting Student Research Program (VSRP). Fully funded: monthly stipend housing health insurance and return flights. 130 students selected annually across 150+ projects.

name: Max Planck CS Research Internship
eligibility: Exceptional bachelor's master's and doctoral students worldwide with background in Computer Science.
description: Research internships at Max Planck Institutes for Informatics Software Systems and Security and Privacy in all areas of Computer Science.

name: Telora Fellowship
eligibility: Young hackers and builders interested in starting startups.
description: Fellowship that helps hackers start startups. Application process designed to help you succeed. Light on words heavy on actions.

name: Unusual Academy
eligibility: Teams of 2-4 members with at least 1 technical co-founder. US-incorporated companies at any stage from idea to production.
compensation_details: Up to $1M uncapped SAFE + 3% program fee
description: Intensive one-week program in the Bay Area focused on product-market fit. Personalized mentorship from top enterprise software founders. Curriculum runs counter to conventional VC accelerator advice.

name: PearX Accelerator
eligibility: Founders building part-time or full-time. Strong focus on AI companies.
description: Small batch accelerator for elite founders. Over 90% of companies raise a seed round after the program.

name: NEXT 36
eligibility: Individual application. All eligible co-founders should also apply separately.
description: Selects 36 of the most entrepreneurial undergrads and recent grads from coast-to-coast who have what it takes to build Canada's next unicorn.
notes: Check website for current cycle deadline

name: Soma Fellows
compensation_details: Up to $2M uncapped SAFE at 0% equity
description: Up to $2M uncapped funding. Join 30+ unicorn founders. Build the next Fortune 500 company. No equity dilution.

name: AI2 Incubator
eligibility: Top-tier founders creating AI-first startups. Seattle-based program.
compensation_details: Up to $600K + up to $1M in compute credits
description: Born from the Allen Institute for AI. Leverages deep technical expertise and Pacific Northwest AI community to help build transformative AI-first companies.

name: Recurse Center
eligibility: Must already know how to code. Self-directed programmers looking to improve.
description: Self-directed community-driven educational retreat for programmers in NYC. Choose 6-week or 12-week batches. Living expense grants available.

name: Included VC Fellowship
eligibility: Aspiring VCs serious about breaking into the venture capital industry.
description: Mission to increase diversity in venture capital. Part-time (15+ hrs/week) alongside work or study. Masterclasses and workshops with leading global VC funds.

name: 8VC Fellowship
eligibility: Undergraduate students placed in contributing roles at innovative startups.
description: Immersive three-month internship program placing undergrads in contributing roles at some of the world's most innovative startups.

name: Afore x Gamma Fund
eligibility: Open to pre-product and pre-revenue teams.
description: Ideas to reality fund. Gamma is a promotional partner only. All investment decisions made solely by Afore Capital.

name: Neo Scholars
eligibility: Undergraduates who excel at CS.
description: Scholarship program for outstanding undergraduate CS students.

name: SPC Founder Fellowship
eligibility: Anyone in the midst of or thinking about a professional transition looking for a talent-dense community of intentional builders.
compensation_details: $1M total: $400K for 7% equity upfront, $600K guaranteed in next outside-led round
description: Guided path through -1 to 0 for founders committed to starting a venture-scale company. Partner mentorship small peer cohorts and no set deadlines or demo days.

name: HF0 Residency
eligibility: Repeat and high-performing technical founders.
description: Residency for repeat founders. Provides housing meals and removes all logistical barriers. Environment engineered for flow and deep work.

name: 776 Foundation Fellowship
eligibility: Ages 18-24 from anywhere in the world. May not be enrolled in higher education during the fellowship.
description: Twenty fellowships of $100K each awarded per cycle. Unrestricted funding for whatever you need to bring your idea to life. Founded by Alexis Ohanian. Access to 776 founder networks and resources.

name: Cansbridge Fellowship
eligibility: Undergraduates enrolled in a Canadian college or university pursuing business science design or technology.
description: Canada's launchpad for the next generation of founders and leaders. Includes international work experience in Asia and a conference in San Francisco.

name: Sequoia Arc
eligibility: Pre-seed and seed stage founders.
description: Bi-annual open call for outlier early-stage founders. Small cohorts of ~10 companies with 1:1 time with Sequoia team. Access to Ampersand digital hub and Builder community.
notes: Sign up for notifications when applications open

name: FR8
description: Where young mavericks build the future. Program for founders nerds and scientists working at the frontier.

name: Unshackled Ventures
eligibility: Immigrant founders who need visa sponsorship to build in the US.
compensation_details: $150K for 10% equity (founder-in-residence) or pre-seed round under $1M
description: The only VC firm exclusively backing immigrant founders through green card support. 200+ founders sponsored with 100% visa filing success rate. Full immigration support and community.

name: Palantir Startup Fellowship
eligibility: Series B or earlier-stage startup. At least one dev committed full-time. Must be committed to building on AIP.
compensation_details: Free access to Palantir AIP platform + dedicated engineering support
description: Elite cohort of startups building agentic AI products on Palantir AIP with hands-on support from Palantir team. Ship your product in 8 weeks. Equity-free.
